manifest.name: 汇率
manifest.author: Yggdrasil
manifest.description: 查汇率与换算（Frankfurter，欧洲央行数据，不需要密钥）。

endpoints.name: currencies
endpoints.label: 可用币种
endpoints.description: List every currency code this service knows, as { "CODE": "Name" } (about 30 of them, all from the European Central Bank). Call it before using a code you are not sure about — an unknown code makes the other two operations fail with "not found".

endpoints.name: latest
endpoints.label: 汇率 / 换算
endpoints.description: The latest exchange rate, optionally converting an amount. Give from (base, e.g. USD) and to (one or more targets separated by commas, e.g. CNY,EUR). Returns amount, base, date and rates{"CNY": 6.69}. Set amount to convert that many units (amount=100, from=USD → rates are for 100 USD). Dates are the ECB working day, so the newest date can be a few days old on a weekend.

params.name: to
params.description: target code, or several separated by commas (CNY,EUR,JPY)

params.name: amount
params.description: convert this many units of the base currency

endpoints.emptyHint: {"message":"not found"} with HTTP 404 means one of the currency codes is not in the list. Call currency.currencies to see the valid codes; do not retry the same pair.

endpoints.name: history
endpoints.label: 历史汇率
endpoints.description: Daily rates over a date range. Give start and end as YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) and the same from / to as the other operations. Returns rates{"2026-09-01": {"CNY": 6.72}, ...}. Weekends and holidays have no rates, so the returned end_date can be earlier than the end you asked for — say which range actually came back instead of assuming.

params.name: to
params.description: target code, or several separated by commas

endpoints.emptyHint: 404 "not found" means a bad currency code or a date range with no data. Check both; do not retry the same request.

guide:
# currency

Exchange rates and conversion from the European Central Bank (via Frankfurter). No API key, no account.

## Workflow

- "100 美元是多少人民币" → `currency.latest` with `amount: 100`, `from: USD`, `to: CNY`.
- "欧元和日元呢" → one call, `to: "EUR,JPY"` — do not call once per currency.
- "上个月美元兑人民币怎么走的" → `currency.history` with a date range, then render a small line chart or a table.
- Unsure whether a code exists → `currency.currencies` first (it is ~30 codes, all ECB currencies).

## Rules

- **Only ~30 currencies exist here**, and they are the ECB reference set: CNY, USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, HKD, KRW… but **not** crypto, not TWD, not every exotic code. If a call returns `{"message":"not found"}`, read `currency.currencies` and tell the user the code is unsupported — do not retry it.
- **The date is a working day.** On a weekend the newest available date is Friday's. Do not present the rate as "right now"; give the date the response contains (`date` field).
- **Show the units.** `amount` is the base amount, so "100 USD = 669.28 CNY" is right; dropping `amount` means the rate is per 1 unit.
- `history` returns the **actual** covered range as `start_date` / `end_date`; weekends and holidays are missing. Say "9 月 1–30 日（其中 6 天没有数据）" rather than implying a value for every day.
- Round sensibly (2 decimals for fiat) and always show which currency pair and which date.
- This is reference data, not trading advice, and it is not live-ticking. Do not add commentary about markets.

## When something is empty or fails

- HTTP 404 + `not found` → bad currency code or an empty date range. Check the code list; do not retry in a loop.
- The request fails in the browser → the network is down or something is blocking `api.frankfurter.app`. Report it; the service needs no key, so it is not a configuration problem.
